item.title: How to make a Focus of Ultimate Power: A Guide
item.content:encoded:
A hastily written panic response to a failure to understand the rules, in the form of an easy-to-follow guide to making focuses of ultimate power. Seeing as the Serpent's Hand hub was the one that I read from the most, that was the GOI-format I went with writing.

Thanks to the following people in chat: salvagebar + ihp for helping with ritual creation, TheEditor for checking the photo, Croquembouche + monorail for critting, anyone else I may have forgotten, and Avocadonut and bluesoul for the following inspirational quotes:

<Avocadonut>: don't be a quitter, be a winner
<bluesoul>: bendenewb i don't know the format but some advice my grandpa gave me was that sometimes the real serpent's hand is the friends we make along the way

The image was taken by me, on my desk. I also wrote the Latin on the card, but am not named Paul.

item.title: BEST ARTICLE
item.content:encoded: This, this, is one of the best articles I have read in a long time. Keep it up!!!
